title: Man Utd's 2009 final XI
brief: Name the ten outfield players who started for Man Utd against Barcelona in the 2009 Champions League final (27 May 2009), when they lost 2-0. The goalkeeper (Edwin van der Sar) is left out.

notes.Carlos Tevez: Carlos Tevez came on as a substitute in the 2009 final, so he did not start.
notes.Dimitar Berbatov: Dimitar Berbatov came on as a substitute in the 2009 final, so he did not start.
notes.Paul Scholes: Paul Scholes came on as a substitute in the 2009 final, so he did not start.

checks: Starting XI, positions and shirt numbers from the team sheet on the final's Wikipedia page; the same eleven players and shirt numbers are on the Transfermarkt match report. Positions are Wikipedia's.
